why: The repository targets the M5Stack Cardputer-Adv (README: "A flight tracking firmware for the Cardputer ADV"), a different board from the original Cardputer (Stamp-S3A with a TCA8418 I2C keyboard, ES8311, BMI270, versus the original's GPIO key matrix), and states no support for the original. The m5cardputer recipe was Jr's old 'Cardputer ADV -> m5cardputer' mapping; the edge now lives in m5cardputer-adv__cardputer-abs-b-radar. ADV-only in two independent blind audits (review room entries 12118 and 12122).

# m5cardputer x cardputer-abs-b-radar

`cardputer-abs-b-radar` describes itself as "A flight tracking firmware for the Cardputer ADV". The Cardputer ADV is different hardware from the original Cardputer (`m5cardputer`), so whether this firmware runs on the original Cardputer is unverified. Status `unverified` until someone with the hardware confirms it.

- README — https://github.com/Jay-Jayismyname1/Cardputer-ADV-B-Radar/blob/9df5e7de309d8469393a626465dde6d8b6bf5147/README.md
